entries.label: Tithe Cart
entries.prompt: COMPOSITION FIRST: a small complete figure-and-action group in the UPPER THIRD of a tall continuous environment. Head tops y12-20%, lowest feet/hands/working-object ends y38-40%. No person taller than18%ofcanvas. Increase environment scale instead of close-up figures. The living group MUST NOT sit at vertical centre or extend below45%. Lower55% still contains the explicitly authored VISIBLE environment, in broad simple low-contrast shapes, never a blank field or fade. This is NOT a central portrait. Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE completely fresh opaque5:7 portrait Practice illustration. Composition quality of Dean Cornwell, N.C.Wyeth and Howard Pyle: compelling narrative staging, expressive silhouette and gesture, purposeful asymmetry, selected edges, broad connected value and colour masses, one decisive action. Dark fantasy is the SUBJECT, not an instruction to underexpose the picture. Hand-placed pixel clusters/hard edges/selective dithering and restricted palette as in the inspected l5/l6 surface references; do not copy their subjects or eyes. All human/dead/sculpted faces entirely indiscernible at FULL SIZE: back-facing heads, opaque hood interiors, closed helmets, corpse heads wrapped/turned away/buried. No readable eyes/nose/mouth or frontal skull portraits. Skeletal rib cages, spines, limbs, mummified torsos and anonymous corpses MUST be materially recognisable; not decorative stick scratches. Architecture and machinery are built FROM the dead, with meaningful load-bearing corpse foundations. Non-graphic decay, no exposed organs, fresh wounds or dismemberment in progress. Keep the institution’s useful action legible. Main living figures, hands and identifying working object grouped in upper central45%, but the painting is ONE continuous inhabited environment from top to bottom. Lower55% is an AREA OF REST WITH VISIBLE MATERIAL FORMS, not empty negative space: broad low-contrast mid-values, contextual ground/fabric/water/architecture, soft edges and restrained texture. It may be pale or middle-valued; reserve strongest contrast for upper action. NO blank black rectangle, fade-to-black, vignette, artificial horizontal divider, high foreground parapet, or repeated elevated walkway before a giant arch. Do not force70%dark or5%light ratios. Do not scatter equal bright highlights. Show varied viewpoints and character arrangements specified below, rather than repainting the previous composition. Read at70x100 pixels. No text, writing, UI, card border/frame, watermark or decorative pasted logo. Cult shape is diegetic physical construction, distinct from current faction allegiance. CLASS PALETTE: Warm straw/butter yellow primary, rose pink accent, subdued plum/stone. Yellow fabric is warm like aged yellow banners, not lemon, ivory or orange. PATRON: Hollow Sun: empty ring with three falling rays, never a pupil or eye; corpse-root sanctity and surrender. MATURITY: Frontier: smaller inherited, broken yet functioning institution, already rooted in corpse-built history. AUTHORED ACTION AND VIEWPOINT: High oblique view across a poor village yard: two warm-yellow hooded collectors heave a grain sack into a tilting pink-draped cart. The cart’s old structural frame consists of bound skeletal bodies, their ribs bracing the wheels and a small empty-ring copper fitting marking its cult. AUTHORED RESTING ENVIRONMENT: A broad muddy wheel track curves past flattened straw, decayed fence boards and a long faded pink cover in the foreground. Large visible ground shapes carry the eye upward. Preserve the card’s existing mechanic: Resource conversion/production as a useful institution. Inherited corpses in the construction are history, not a new ongoing population cost. Do not add a new sacrifice ritual or imply this card consumes a living person. CRITICAL SURFACE: NOT photoreal, NOT smooth3D, NOT realistic miniature rendering. Large discrete flat pixel clusters with deliberately stepped silhouette edges and selective coarse dithering; simplify bone, grass, fabric and masonry into broad connected shapes with sparse pixel marks. No individual grass hairs or pores, no noisy realistic textures. Use the inspected pixel references as surface guidance, not a scene to copy. NO BARE SKULLS: all skeletal and corpse heads must be missing, completely wrapped in cloth, capped by closed helmets, buried or turned fully away. Keep recognisable ribs/spines/body silhouettes. No eye sockets or toothed skull faces anywhere, even background masonry. Principal live figures and identifying action remain upper central45%; lower setting is visible yet quieter and simpler than action.
